Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations offset extended valuation risks.

Silver.note: Industrial solar demand and high beta to gold momentum drive outperformance.

Copper.note: Structural mine supply deficits and grid investment outweigh China property weakness.

Uranium.note: Nuclear renaissance and structural utility contracting create a multi-year supply deficit.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply from new global projects and slowing EV growth curtail upside.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply surplus and weak stainless steel demand pressure prices.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate supply and smelter curtailments support prices despite soft macro demand.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness offsets marginal stimulus and seasonal restocking.

Coal.note: Tight seaborne supply balances against long-term thermal demand destruction.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls tighten supply but weak EV and wind demand caps upside.

Manganese.note: South African logistics bottlenecks offset by weak global steelmaking demand.

PGM.note: Platinum substitution in auto catalysts and South African power constraints support margins.

Potash.note: Geopolitical supply risks balance against high prices curbing agricultural application rates.

Aluminum.note: Chinese capacity caps and green transition demand tighten the global market balance.

Diversified.note: Copper and gold tailwinds are perfectly offset by iron ore and coal headwinds.
